 While actor Park Jin-young gave 1,000 points for his acting chemistry with Kim Yoo-jung, he revealed the story of being celebrated with three cakes at the closing party on the day he finished filming because his birthday was the same even though he was five years older.
 On the 26th, the Elle Korea channel released a video of Kim Yoo-jung and Park Jin-young, the two main characters of tvN's drama "100 Days of Lies", answering questions about each other.
 On this day, the two talked about the unexpected commonality of having the same birthday. Park Jin-young was born on September 22, 1994, and Kim Yoo-jung was born on September 22, 1999, exactly five years apart, but the date of birth is the same.
 사진 확대 While Park Jin-young gave 1,000 points for her acting chemistry with Kim Yoo-jung, she revealed the story of being celebrated with three cakes at the end of the shoot on the same birthday even though she was five years older. Photo = Elle Korea Channel 사진 확대 사진 확대 사진 확대 When asked if they had ever exchanged birthday gifts with each other, Park Jin-young laughed, saying, "I love that we can be blunt with each other."
 On the last day of filming, there was even a birthday celebration. The shooting ended a day before the two's birthdays, and the end of the evening was held.
 Park Jin-young said that people who were with her prepared a cake just before 12 p.m. At that time, three cakes appeared, and Park Jin-young recalled her gratitude to those who took care of her birthday.
 Earlier in September, when asked about his romance with Kim Yoo-jung at the production presentation of "100 Days of Lies", Park Jin-young drew attention by saying that he scored 1,000 out of 100. Kim Yoo-jung also said that they worked well enough to communicate with each other just by looking at each other's eyes.
 Even at the actual filming site, the two people had a good laugh code. Kim Yoo-jung said, "When I'm in a certain space, I think the points of the funny moment are the same," adding that she felt like Park Jin-young.
 Park Jin-young explained the process of getting close while filming, saying, "We got close by sharing funny videos one by one."
 What surprised Park Jin-young again when she saw Kim Yoo-jung was the size of her eyes.
 Park Jin-young confessed, "I thought my eyes were not small, but when I saw Yoo-jung, I wondered how her eyes could be this big."
 As a result, the two opened their eyes wide side by side and immediately acknowledged the commonality of a "big-eyed couple," causing laughter.
 Meanwhile, tvN's "100 Days of Lies," starring Kim Yoo-jung and Park Jin-young, broke its own record in the sixth episode, which aired on the 25th, recording 9.5% of viewership based on paid households nationwide.
 [Kim Seunghye, MK Sports Reporter]
